facts.business: Asian Warehousing Limited provides agricultural warehousing services, including storage, weigh bridge, and related logistics solutions, primarily serving the food grain sector and institutions like the Food Corporation of India.

auditor.name: M/s Ramesh M. Sheth & Associates, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Dependence on FCI and government procurement policies for warehousing demand
Regional storage capacity imbalances rather than nationwide shortages
Small scale of operations with only 8 employees, limiting operational bandwidth
High finance costs relative to revenue (Rs 69.71 lakhs on Rs 179.10 lakhs revenue)
Low current ratio (0.03) indicating severe liquidity constraints
Concentration risk from wind-down of trading activity and shift to pure services model
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transaction with Mr. Vishnu Singh, CFO, for remuneration not exceeding Rs 28.20 lakhs per annum (AGM Resolution No. 4).
